title: Prove exact native BIT payload peaks and caller composition
body:
## Summary

Prove exact retained payload-array peaks for the source-pinned native ADD, atom swap and sign routines, and join that component to PR2882's packet caller envelope.

```text
suspended packet caller C(t,j)
  + borrowed local                 counted by caller
  + native private payload         exact new component
      ADD                          2F+3
      atom swap, w=1 / w>=2         2F+q^2+1 / 3F+q^2+2
      digit sign, w=1 / w>=2        3F+4 / 3F+q+2
      PR2753 linear sign           F+1
  = restricted upper bound max(B, C_max + A_payload)
```

The pending result belongs to the private cohort until return, then becomes caller `changed`, with its array counted once. Cleared arrays retain their lengths. For the predecessor's N=2,F=9,K=19,D=7,Q=4 example, structural B=92 becomes a restricted bound of 94 for ADD, 105 for digit sign and 92 for linear sign.

Start with [README and scope](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4141dafd49e098e521c51fd31c5b6ea0c2fd0854/research/selected-native-payload-backing/README.md) and [source/lifetime proof](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4141dafd49e098e521c51fd31c5b6ea0c2fd0854/research/selected-native-payload-backing/PROOF.md). The package includes byte-identical source exports, exact pins, generated receipt and a registered standard-library checker.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR2882 explicitly leaves native private A unpriced. PR2566 already proves the three-volume live-bit bound and reused lane schedule; those results remain predecessor credit.
  **After:** exact retained reference-array lengths and a restricted same-cut caller composition, corroborated by 60 complete native fixtures, 22 complete origin-bit-plane executions and 13 controls.
- Registered Python 3.12.15 replay passes. Git-free read-only optimized Python 3.14.8 replay passes. All ten exported files match their original Git blobs; final committed-byte check passes for all 21 package files.
- Repository research-workflow checks pass 138 tests, with seven environment/platform skips. See VALIDATION.md for commands, environment and instrumentation exceptions.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-native-payload-backing
```

Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml PR2697, David Arias PR2753, ywz65 PR2566, and kumagi PR2882, retaining Ross Richardson PR2874, starship-s PR2731, Nick Petalas PR2743 and the source notices. Exact heads and hashes are in SOURCES.json. Substantial AI assistance was used; no independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed.

Task supplier-boundary-audit, chooser ec414f6906613ebd2622895086aa7b15, priority revision 5, refined to the released native-action payload handoff. [Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18967752). Started at main a1bfbc677 and fast-forwarded to refreshed main ba3de4729; relevant priorities and scientific sources are unchanged. Submission overlap covers 489 open PRs, 2,104 closed/merged PRs and 1,565 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings; arbitrary diffs and unpublished work are excluded.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** research.

New scoped package only. A_payload is not total A. Counters, numerical words, callbacks/records, total caller reserve, physical reuse/erasure/movement, stronger time contracts and supplier admission remain separate. No new kappa, selected frontier change, full selected cold replay or hosted-CI pass is claimed.
